# Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide guidance in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Before project work, read `START_HERE.md`, `current-project.md`, and, when writing public-facing content, `about-me.md`.

The site is a collection of static HTML pages in the repository root. Shared styles are in `styles.css` and `assets/css/`; scripts are in `js/`; images are in `images/`. Root files are the live site source. `Test/` is a non-live working copy and should not be edited unless requested. `sources/` and `outputs/` are reference and draft folders.

Preserve existing filenames, relative links, and page conventions. Keep changes focused and accessible, verify facts and links when relevant, and flag unresolved conflicts. The GitHub workflow deploys root files to the live site on pushes to `main`; do not push or deploy without the owner's explicit approval.
